items.title: Last Straws: John Chaffe, Bris Jones, Bill Lee, Frank De La Houssaye, Bob Ice Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: I didn't know him. He died when I was first getting interested in playing. And everyone was talking about Snooze.

ctx.x: That's right. Not Malcolm, I hope.
Do you remember Snoozer Quinn over there?

I heard quite a bit about him. I didn't know him. He died when I was first getting interested in playing. And everyone was talking about Snooze. I believe he played with White when it was something like that.
